sn13.11:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati || || Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso Sinerussa pabbatarājassa satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā upanikkhipeyya || || Taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave || Katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ || yā vā satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā upanikkhittā yo vā Sineru pabbatarājāti || ||
sn13.11:2.1: Etad eva bhante bahutaraṃ yad idaṃ Sineru pabbatarājā || appamattikā satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā upanikkhittā || neva satimaṃ kalam upenti na sahassimam kalam upenti na satasahassimaṃ kalam upenti Sinerupabattarājānam upanidhāya satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā upanikkhittā ti || ||
sn13.11:3.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa adhigamam upanidhāya aññatitthiya-samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-paribbājakānaṃ adhigamo neva satimaṃ kalam upeti na sahassimaṃ kalam upeti na satasahassimam kalam upeti || || Evam mahādhigamo bhikkhave diṭṭhisampanno puggalo evam mahābhiññoti || || Abhisamaya-saṃyuttaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ || ||
sn13.11:4.0: Tassa uddānaṃ || || Nakasikhā Pokkharanī || Sambhejja udake ca dve || Dve Pathavī dve Samuddā || Tayo ca Pabbatūpamā ti || ||
